mechanism: Acyclovir may increase CNS effects and neurotoxicity risk when combined with perphenazine, a typical antipsychotic with anticholinergic and CNS depressant properties; additive CNS depression and potential for neurotoxic manifestations.
action: Monitor for signs of neurotoxicity (confusion, hallucinations, tremor, seizures) and CNS depression; ensure adequate hydration with acyclovir and consider dose adjustment if renal impairment present.
